articleTitle: AVSecure: An Audio-Visual Watermarking Framework for Proactive Deepfake Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The rise of Deepfake technology presents a significant challenge to the integrity of information. Most existing Deepfake detection methods rely on visual artifacts to distinguish between the authentic and manipulated content, but they are unable to cope with unseen tampering method and easily affected by post-processing. Although recent investigations have tried to proactively protect facial images using deep watermarking techniques, more deceptive Deepfakes often incorporate both visual and audio modalities. To address this issue, we propose a novel proactive Deepfake detection framework for both audio and visual modalities by utilizing a unified encoder-decoder architecture to embed audio-visual watermarks. Also, an audiovisual feature encoder is developed to align the audio and visual information. The multi-modal watermarking is designed to embed a watermark as the detection clue in each modality respectively and conduct verification of both modalities together to detect Deepfaked multimedia. By adding a distortion layer between embedding and extracting during training, the embedded watermark is able to be robust against common post-processing operations (e.g., JPEG compression) while remaining sensitive to Deepfake manipulations (e.g., SimSwap) in the water-mark verification. Our experimental results on VidTIMIT have demonstrated that the proposed watermarking framework can effectively detect various advanced Deepfake manipulations and achieve good robustness to different kinds of common distortions compared with passive uni-modal and multi-modal Deepfake detection methods.

articleTitle: Research on Localization Techniques in Occluded Environments Based on Lora Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of positioning failure, multipath fading, signal power attenuation, and high energy consumption faced by BeiDou satellite navigation signal propagation in a sheltered environment, this paper proposes a logarithmic distance path loss model of Lora signal by utilizing the long-distance and low-energy propagation characteristics of Lora signal. Based on verifying the correctness of the model, the Lora+RTK+ Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) positioning system is constructed, two typical scene models of the plaza and dense forest area are selected, and the ranging error is corrected based on the Kalman filtering method, in the plaza scene, after optimization of Kalman filtering, the error of x-axis is 3.15m, the error of y-axis is 0.8m, and the error of z-axis is -2.30m; and in the dense forest scene, the x-axis error is -4.77m, the y-axis error is 1.40m, and the z-axis error is 5.60m, which improves the accuracy of the algorithm from the perspective of real measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-source Data Security Fusion Analysis Technology Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the multi-source data security fusion analysis technology based on federated learning. A rapid model convergence technique based on data distribution difference evolution comparison is proposed to explore the data distribution law among participants and accelerate the model convergence speed. In view of the difference of data distribution among participants, the difference between local data distribution and global data distribution is obtained by analyzing the evolution law of data distribution of participants. Then, the weight is assigned according to the similarity between the data distribution of each participant, and it is used to guide the rapid convergence of the global global model, and improve the convergence speed of the machine learning model based on the federated learning framework. A collaborative optimization technology based on cooperative game is proposed, which takes into account the performance of individual modeling and global modeling, and improves the accuracy of the model. The accuracy of the global model and the accuracy of each participant's local personalized model are considered for scenarios that need to meet both the participant's personalized modeling and global modeling requirements. Through the cooperative game model, the accuracy optimization of the global model and the local personalized model of each participant is solved, and the coordination of the accuracy of the global model and the local personalized model is realized.

articleTitle: Edge-Joint Assisted and Salient Enhanced Self-Supervised Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: We propose an algorithm that focuses on edge joints and salient features in human skeleton data. The edge joint consistency module filters strong connectivity to emphasize weakly connected joints, capturing subtle action differences, especially for similar actions. The self-attention-enhanced salient feature module learns local salient features through attention masks, highlighting crucial action-specific details while maintaining global context. This approach improves action recognition by better utilizing joint connectivity and enhancing feature distinction between classes.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Enhancement Embedded Algorithm Based on Improved Ghost Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Underwater image enhancement algorithms create conditions for subsequent processing tasks such as recognition, classification, and reconstruction. Usually, the stronger the performance of embedded devices, the higher their image processing capabilities and speed. However, due to limitations in application environment and current embedded development board performance, algorithms on embedded development boards should seek a subtle balance between high performance and high processing speed. This article is based on the FUnIE GAN network, using an improved Ghost module to compress the network model, using the Fused MBConv module to shorten the network training time, and using TensorRT strategy to further optimize the algorithm.

articleTitle: Cross Validation Aided AMP-MMV Detector for Uplink Grant-Free NOMA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Grant-free non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) has been regarded as one of the key techniques for the next generation of wireless communications, especially suitable for massive machine-type communication (mMTC) scenarios. In addition, compressed sensing (CS) algorithms has been identified as a potential candidate for multiuser detection due to the natural sparsity of user activity in mMTC. The approximate message passing multiple measurement vector (AMP-MMV) algorithm with minimum mean square error (MMSE) denoiser is an efficient CS-based multiuser detection method, but it relies on prior knowledge of active user sparsity, which is difficult to obtain in practice. In this paper, we propose a cross validation (CV) aided MMSE-AMP-MMV (CVA-AMP-MMV) algorithm that can adaptively estimate the true user sparsity in frame- based uplink grant-free NOMA system. Active user detection is performed in parallel during the sparse estimation process without the need for additional detection steps. Simulation results show that the proposed CVA-AMP-MMV algorithm achieves the same performance as the MMSE-AMP-MMV algorithm at a slight complexity cost.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Detection of Object Dynamic Change Based on Image Characteristic of Structural Functional Unit (SFU)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In high-resolution remote sensing image, the change of object structural functional unit (SFU) is an important indicative feature to measure the overall dynamic change of object. The research of the chronological phase characteristics of typical object SFU, provides information services for object identification and early warning in the field of intelligence analysis. Facing different types of object SFU, the spectral data of multi-temporal high-resolution remote sensing image were extracted as the sample data set, with the analytical method of Euclidean distance. This method detects the level of object type, SFU and chronological phase. The experimental results show that, by studying the spectral data of multi-temporal object SFU, the chronological phase can be detected reliably, as the type of the overall object can be identified in the medium term of construction. The analytical method of Euclidean distance can effectively detect the SFU of the whole object and effectively shorten the time to identify the object based on diagnostic SFU providing reference basis for the early identification of unknown object types and its construction phase.

articleTitle: Optimizing Charging Strategies for Electric Vehicles in Residential Areas Based on Neiderreit Sequence Initialized Tasmanian Devil Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EV) have attracted the attention of many consumers due to their energy-saving and environmentally friendly characteristics. However, as the number of EVs continues to increase, a large number of EVs, when randomly connected to the power distribution network through charging stations, will cause a large-scale uncertain electricity load burden on the power distribution network. Therefore, it is meaningful to study the proper way to manage the increasing charging behavior of EVs and achieve their orderly charging. In recent years, scholars have been particularly inclined to describe the optimization of EV charging strategies as a multi-objective optimization problem. However, a considerable number of EV charging strategy models have an objective function that is essentially L1 norm, which is a non-smooth optimization problem. In order to effectively optimize its parameters, in this paper, an algorithm that does not rely on gradient information for global optimization has been proposed, which is called Neiderreit sequence initiated tasmanian devil optimization (NSTDO). NSTDO can overcome the shortcomings of commonly used coordinate descent (CD) method and sub gradient descent (SubGD) method, which are prone to falling into the trap of local minima and unable to find the global optimal solution. Via numerical experiment, the effectiveness of the proposed NSTDO algorithm has been verified.

articleTitle: Optimize Sparse Antenna Arrays with Chaotic Mapping Snow Ablation Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the utilization of the chaotic mapping snow ablation optimizer (CSAO) algorithm in sparse antenna arrays. In this paper, we use the following method to optimize the element position of an array mode with a minimum sidelobe level (SLL) by keeping the current amplitude equal to 1 and the phase invariance. This study presents multiple design examples to showcase the efficacy of CSAO (chaotic mapping snow ablation optimizer) in optimizing sparse arrays for achieving array models with the lowest SLL and precise positioning in a specified direction. Comparing the optimized results with those obtained by other popular evolutionary algorithms, it can be concluded that CSAO algorithm has lower SLL reduction, so its optimization ability is relatively stronger. In summary, this study proves the feasibility of CSAO algorithm in optimizing thin array and other problems of electromagnetism.

articleTitle: ED-YOLO: A Deep Learning and Edge Detection Based Turnout Switch Gap Monitor Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: A real-time monitoring method for turnout switch gaps based on deep learning and edge detection, named EDYOLO, is proposed to accurately monitor the fastening status of turnouts by identifying the scale readings of the turnout extension indicator rods. The difference between these readings and the baseline scale is calculated to obtain the distance of the switch indicator gaps. To transmit data from embedded clients deployed at the turnout edge to a remote monitoring center server, the system integrates two wireless communication technologies: 4G and LoRa. Additionally, Bluetooth communication technology is integrated to allow railway administrators to configure the embedded clients conveniently using handheld terminals. A prototype is implemented based on Raspberry Pi, and experimental results show that the maximum error of the proposed system in gap monitoring is less than 0.1 millimeters. Furthermore, the server can poll and remotely collect gap data from at least 60 clients per minute.

articleTitle: Optimizing Linear Antenna Arrays with The Chaotic Gold Rush Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the gold rush optimization algorithm to an antenna array for the first time. We have enhanced the gold rush optimization algorithm by introducing logistic-tent mapping, resulting in the Chaotic Gold Rush Optimizer (CGRO). This innovative approach effectively overcomes the limitations of premature convergence to local optima, facilitating the design of linear antenna arrays with improved directivity and reduced side lobe levels (SLL). The proposed algorithm is utilized for the synthesis of sparse linear array antennas. Findings demonstrate its ability to further reduce peak sidelobe levels and enhance the functionality of linear sparse arrays. The high adaptability and efficiency of CGRO in optimizing complex antenna designs provide a promising tool for achieving optimal antenna configurations in wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Attention Fusion and Edge-Guided Structural Enrichment Completion Network for Leaf Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction is an important task to capture the spatial structure and morphological features of plants. However, the occlusion between leaves resulted in an incomplete point cloud. It thus affects the accuracy of plant phenotype analysis. To obtain complete leaf point clouds, a Multi-Layer Attention Fusion and Edge-Guided Structural Enrichment Network (MAEGNet) was proposed for the Leaf Point Cloud Completion. It designed multiple layers of attention fusion modules and an edge-preserving loss function, using a Transformer to process and fuse local and global features of leaves at varying receptive fields. It encouraged the model to recover the leaf edge structure by calculating the loss between the edges extracted from the completed and ground-truth leaf point clouds. Experimental results show that our model can achieve a better result on our constructed leaf point cloud dataset. The Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) is reduced by 7.44 cm.

articleTitle: Research on a New High Speed Harmonic Identification Technology for Power Systems Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of new power technology, the number of new access equipment in the power system has shown a continuous growth trend, and the accompanying harmonic hazards have also become a necessary concern. In order to solve these problems, this article proposes a harmonic high -speed identification technology based on digital twin technology. This technology uses a compressed sensing method to sample the electrical energy quality signal at a rate below Naquist sampling rate, and stores more information with lower data volume to accelerate data collection speed. In terms of information recovery, this article uses the orthogonal matching tracking algorithm to realize the recovery of the compressed perception signal. In order to increase the speed of signal recovery, this article uses digital twin technology to model the collection nodes and computing power nodes, and combined with decentralized calculation methods, the artificial hummingbird algorithm is used as a signal recovery adjustment. Through experimental verification, the signal collected by compression perception can be well reproduced the spectrum of the original signal after recovery, which is convenient for harmonic identification; It has been further improved.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cell Allocation in 6TiSCH Networks based on Node Density Using K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The 6TiSCH architecture is instrumental in meeting the stringent requirements of industrial IoT for reliable coordinated communication. Effective cell allocation is paramount in dense node traffic distribution patterns to avoid packet loss. This paper introduces a K-means clustering to optimize cell allocation by mapping communication needs between nodes to improve network performance. Through evaluation across various node scenarios and comparison between MSF and grid-based K-means results, this strategy demonstrates improvements in average performance metrics: a 9.03% increase in Packet Delivery Ratio, a 20.07% reduction in End-to-End Latency, a 21.99% decrease in Joining Times, and a 25.48% enhancement in Throughput.

articleTitle: Radio Interference Source Localization with UAV-Based Q-Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Expanding aerial monitoring methods is of great significance to radio management, that contributes to regulatory spectrum monitoring and interference hunting especially aviation interference. In this paper, a Q-Learning algorithm based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is proposed to locate radio interference sources under the Rayleigh channel. This method locates radio interference sources through times of interaction with the environment and self-learning, which can operate without any prior knowledge about the environment or the model for received signal strength (RSS) observations. Firstly, a signal model considering Rayleigh fading is established. Secondly, the problems of state division, action division, immediate reward and exploration strategy are discussed. Finally, Matlab is used to verify the feasibility of using Q-Learning algorithm to autonomously locate radio interference sources with a UAV. The impacts of the number of actions, two kinds of action selection method (ε-greedy and Softmax) on the path were compared by simulation. Comparative experimental results prove that the Q-Learning algorithm can enable the UAV to locate the radio interference source autonomously with a short path. And ε-greedy outperform softmax. When the number of actions is 8, the exploration factor ε is 0.1, and the learning rate is 0.9, the UAV locate the radio interference source with the shortest path.

articleTitle: Array Antenna Based on the Rime-Ice Optimisation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, the rime-ice optimization algorithm is used to optimize the array antenna, in general the rime-ice optimization algorithm is just beginning to be used to optimize the array antenna. The rime-ice optimization algorithm is a new evolutionary class of algorithms inspired by the phenomenon of rime-ice in nature. The algorithm iterates over the populations by updating them through two mechanisms, soft fog search as well as hard fog puncture in conjunction with upward positive greedy selection, to finalize the optimal result. In this paper, the current amplitude is optimized by controlling the antenna array element spacing and phase invariance so that the array directional map has a minimum side lobe level (SLL). To show the capability of the RIME algorithm in optimizing antenna arrays, two examples are given in this paper. The RIME optimization algorithm outperforms non-optimized and other known meta-heuristic optimization algorithms in suppressing the peak SLL. This definitely proves the feasibility of the RIME algorithm for antenna array optimization and even other problems in Electromagnetics.

articleTitle: MLIM: A Multi-Level Integrity Monitoring Method for 5G Indoor Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In the context of smart cities, 5G indoor positioning systems are crucial for improving the quality of location-based services. These systems are composed of multi-point positioning and fingerprint-matching algorithms. However, due to the complexity of indoor environments, 5G indoor positioning systems face challenges in accuracy and robustness. Traditional integrity monitoring algorithms cannot meet the fault monitoring requirements of fusion positioning systems in non-Gaussian noise scenarios. This paper investigates a multi-level integrity monitoring (MLIM) method. Firstly, this multi-level feedback structure enables the algorithm to monitor algorithm output and observations simultaneously, identifying and isolating potential errors promptly. Secondly, the Density-based anomaly detection algorithm is introduced into the MLIM framework to monitor system faults in non-Gaussian noise environments effectively. It identifies abnormal data points by evaluating their local density, maintaining efficient fault detection performance when the noise model is unknown or changing. Finally, the paper tests the performance of the MLIM algorithm at different levels. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed MLIM algorithm significantly reduces the root mean square error and maximum error of 5G positioning systems, and guarantees accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Infrared PV Image Fault Detection Based on FDF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As a clean and sustainable renewable energy, photovoltaic (PV) power generation has been widely used around the world. The power generation efficiency of solar photovoltaic panels is affected by installation and environmental factors, so PV panels require regular cleaning, inspection and maintenance. However, traditional maintenance methods require a lot of labor and time. But in recent years, with the development of UAV technology and the advancement of target detection algorithms, a more efficient solution is provided. This study combines infrared target detection technology, uses drone aerial photography to collect infrared image data of PV power plant scenes, and uses spatial domain-based data enhancement and feature difference fusion (FDF) methods to train a fault detection model. The constructed neural network model can quickly, accurately and comprehensively acquire the types and locations of PV panel faults in PV power plants, significantly reducing labor and time costs. The experimental results show that the method has excellent performance in PV power plant fault detection and can effectively improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of PV power plants.

articleTitle: Smart Blockchain and AI Empowered Web 3.0
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the development and continuous iterative innovation of digital technologies represented by highperformance computing, computing power networks, mixed reality, blockchain, digital twins, and new generation AI technologies, especially the generation of AI, human society is entering an intelligent society with "human-machine-naturerobot-digital human". The social environment on which human lives is moving from the physical reality space to the digital space where virtual and reality coexist. Web3.0 based on blockchain will open a new era of the next generation Internet revolution with the goal of unique decentralized DAO, decentralized network, data autonomy, and digital assets. This paper first analyzes the evolution and development trend of the Internet, proposes an evolution roadmap and a new perspective from blockchain to Web3.0, analyzes the technical roadmap and Rollup technology for blockchain scaling, explores blockchain AI computing and ZKML technology, and finally presents the new future of AI+blockchain enabling Web3.0.

articleTitle: A Novel PV Data Stream Compression and Reconstruction Approach with Signal Residual Observation Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: At present, when user-side distributed PV participates in the multi-level aggregation regulation of power grid, it involves the collection and interaction of massive multiple heterogeneous data, and the data redundancy and data scale are constantly growing, occupying a lot of network resources. In this paper, a distributed photovoltaic data compression algorithm based on signal residual observation matrix (SROM) is proposed, which effectively reduces the data transmitted by the system. Experiments show that this method has a stable reconstruction effect under different distributed PV power generation waveforms.

articleTitle: A Terahertz Dual-frequency Slot Patch Antenna Optimized by INFO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper presents an improved design of a dual band patch antenna operating in the terahertz band. Load double "E" slit on the radiator to change the current distribution on the antenna surface to optimize the antenna's performance. The antenna model is simulated with HFSS electromagnetic simulation software and optimized with the new INFO algorithm. The return loss value of the optimized antenna is greatly reduced in the high resonance band and reaches -48.8dB at f=651GHz. At the same time, antennas can work in near 300GHz (290GHz ~ 310GHz) and near 650GHz (640GHz ~ 670GHz) bands to achieve dual frequency design goals. The antenna has a simple structure and good performance and can meet different optimization design requirements by changing individual parameters.

articleTitle: The Research on Current Status of Digital Technology System of Electric Power Emergency Plan
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Based on the knowledge system of electric power emergency command, study the digitalization technology based on the theories of natural language processing, knowledge mapping, scenario-coping, etc., realize the autonomous recognition, categorization, disassembly and optimization of the text of the emergency plan, establish the ontology model of the plan by using the knowledge mapping, study the scenario-coping technology, set up the relational network model, and establish the digitalization technology system of electric power emergency plan by combining the above theoretical studies. The above theories are combined to establish a digital technology system for electric power emergency plans.

articleTitle: Storage Optimization of Product Traceability System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: To address the storage capacity limitations and high costs inherent in the existing single-chain storage model of blockchain-based traceability systems, a strategy combining on-chain and off-chain storage using IPFS as an alternative storage architecture is proposed. The goal is to enhance the storage model while ensuring data storage stability. Storing frequently accessed information off-chain helps alleviate the excessive pressure on the blockchain caused by high-frequency queries, while ensuring the security and immutability of on-chain data. Additionally, IPFS technology expands storage capacity and reduces storage costs through its distributed storage, thereby improving data storage and retrieval efficiency. Experimental validation shows that compared to traditional single-chain traceability models, this storage optimization approach can reduce data storage time by 8.05% and data retrieval time by 30.97%.

articleTitle: Low-overlap Crop Point Cloud Registration Method based on Improved GeoTransformer with Normal Vectors and Gaussian Curvature
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Crop point cloud registration holds significant importance in measuring and monitoring crop phenotypic features. However, the 3D representation of crops differs from that of indoor or urban scenes due to the pronounced curvature of their trunks, branches, and other components, resulting in lower overlap rates between point clouds. To address this issue, we leverage the discernible normal vectors and curvature features of crops and propose a Gaussian curvature-based enhancement to GeoTransformer for aligning plant point clouds with low overlap rates. This enhancement encodes the geometric attributes of the point cloud. To assess the method's effectiveness, we conducted experiments using real-world data. The proposed method achieves RMSE errors ranging from only 1.7% to 3.8%, 6% to 28.7%, and 28.2% to 51% of those of ICP, Predator, and GeoTransformer, respectively, for low overlap rates (20%) and average values.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial System Operation Pattern Recognition Based on Deep Generative Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As a new digital infrastructure, industrial internet provides massive data for intelligent operation and maintenance of industrial equipment. In order to solve the operation pattern recognition of complex industrial systems, the architecture of digital twins was designed, and the variational self-encoder model considering the influence of operating conditions was proposed.The correlation among the multivariate variables of industrial system was identified by the reconstruction probability.A gas turbine in service was selected for model validation, and the result shows that the proposed model has a higher prediction accuracy and is more sensitive to changes in operating conditions.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Communication Latency Optimization Method Based on Sliding Window and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the growing demand for energy and the increasing global attention to environmental protection, the utilization of renewable energy such as distributed photovoltaic has received more and more attention. Distributed photovoltaic is developing rapidly. The problem of communication latency is also becoming more and more prominent. In this paper, the current situation of distributed photovoltaic communication is analyzed. Secondly, a latency optimization mechanism based on sliding window is proposed to compress packets and reduce latency. Finally, the CNN model is established and trained to predict the distributed photovoltaic communication latency, and the experimental results show that the established CNN model has a good effect on the distributed photovoltaic communication latency prediction, which provides technical support for the grid integration of renewable resources.

articleTitle: Artifact Removal Algorithm for Virtual Viewpoint Images Based on Occlusion-Aware Cavity Dilation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Free Viewpoint Television (FTV) enables viewers to select any viewing angle, enhancing interaction and immersion. Depth Image Based Rendering (DIBR) is notable for reducing the number of transmitted viewpoint images and quickly generating virtual views. However, artifacts in these images degrade quality significantly. This paper proposes an artifact removal algorithm for virtual viewpoint images based on occlusion-aware cavity dilation, addressing the shortcomings of existing methods that indiscriminately apply morphological expansion to all cavities, leading to unnecessary pixel loss. Instead, our proposed method classifies cavity types, selectively applies morphological expansion to the occlusion cavities, and promptly restores the covered foreground edge pixels with their original pixel values. Experimental results show that this algorithm can effectively handle artifact issues in virtual viewpoint rendering, achieving higher quality virtual viewpoint views and outperforming other algorithms in terms of PSNR and SSIM.

articleTitle: Hybrid Positioning Framework with Innovation Based Judgment in Complex Indoor Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In indoor environments, complex structures not only introduce Line of Sight (LOS) paths, but also give rise to Non-Line of Sight (NLOS) paths. This scenario presents immense challenges for positioning technologies. Currently, most existing indoor positioning solutions primarily target either LOS or NLOS environments and employ a singular positioning algorithm, which leads to suboptimal robustness in positioning. In order to tackle this issue, this study proposes a novel indoor hybrid positioning scheme. This model unifies multiple positioning algorithms, allowing each to leverage its advantages in either LOS or NLOS environments. The model, based on the innovation residual judgement result of the Maximum Correlation Entropy Kalman Filter, integrates the output positions from multiple positioning models, thereby adaptively selecting the optimal positioning method. In the event of Line of Sight (LOS) conditions, the model opts for the positioning results obtained from an enhanced CHAN-Kalman position estimation method based on Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA). Conversely, under Non-Line of Sight (NLOS) conditions, we propose a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) fingerprint positioning method based on 5G channel impulse response for position estimation. Upon verification on an open-source dataset, the method proposed in this study can achieve single-point positioning in both LOS and NLOS mixed environments. Compared to single positioning methods, it possesses a higher degree of positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Momentum Prediction Model for Tennis Matches
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In tennis, "Momentum" is an important research field. Through the establishment of an evaluation index system and the use of logistic regression to analyze the significance of the relationship between the index system and the scoring results, machine learning models are utilized for 5-fold cross-validation to develop a model that can capture the emergence of points during the game. This is used to determine the strengths, weaknesses, and performance levels of players on the field, providing visualizations to describe the game’s course based on the model. Explore metrics that can help determine when a match trend shifts from favoring one player to another and utilize match data to construct a model that predicts match trends.

articleTitle: Harmonic Source Identification Based on RF-GSO-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the development of ultra-high voltage and smart grids, the problem of grid harmonic pollution caused by nonlinear loads and equipment has become increasingly serious. In the comprehensive management process of grid harmonics, harmonic source identification is the primary problem to be solved. This paper proposed a harmonic source identification model that utilizes Random Forest (RF) to select important features, Geese Swarm Optimization (GSO) algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model. And then employed the RF-GSO-LSTM model for harmonic source identification. The feature subset selected by RF can simplify model input and reduce information redundancy, while GSO algorithm can select the optimal parameter combination of LSTM model, improving the identification efficiency. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed RF-GSO-LSTM model has better performance.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Algorithm Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Traditional recommendation algorithms, such as collaborative filtering, rely on users' historical behavior and similarity with other users to predict their interests and provide personalized recommendations for content or products. While they can meet certain accuracy requirements for recommendations, recommendation systems still encounter various challenges that are difficult to overcome, such as the cold start problem and data sparsity. As a result, neural network-based recommendation systems have emerged. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are machine learning methods that learn through competition and can generate data that conforms to a certain distribution. Attention mechanisms consider the relationships between each element and other elements in the input sequence, thereby enhancing the expressive power of the model. The proposed approach combines these two mechanisms in a neural network architecture. Experimental results have shown that this algorithm can enhance the accuracy of recommendation results.

articleTitle: Pylon Reconstruction Based on NeRF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a pylon reconstruction method based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) technology. The advantage of this method lies in its ability to reconstruct pylons from images, with a multi-view model maintaining good performance even under complex lighting and occlusion conditions. We demonstrate the process of using NeRF to reconstruct electric power towers through experiments. During the experimental process, we collect images of electric power towers from different environments and angles, then apply NeRF to process these images, using deep learning to learn and generate a network model capable of expressing the scene. The experimental results show that our method can complete the reconstruction of scenes with only image inputs, and the reconstructed models have a certain accuracy in terms of geometric details and textures.

articleTitle: UWB/IMU Integrated Navigation Method Based on Enhanced IMM Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) signals in indoor environments might suffer from positive deviation errors due to the influence of Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS), which leads to inaccurate positioning results. To address the problem, we propose an Error State Kalman Filter (ESKF) fusion algorithm based on enhanced interactive-multi-model (EAIMM), named as EAIMM-ESKF. Firstly, we establish distance models for UWB tags and base stations in LOS and NLOS environments. Moreover, we introduce the dynamically updated probability matrix and forgetting factor to reduce the misjudgment rate of the IMM model and adaptively determine the NLOS deviation. Finally, a fusion framework for UWB and IMU based on ESKF is established. Experimental data indicate that under NLOS occlusion conditions, our proposed approach has a more significant suppression effect on NLOS ranging errors compared to other algorithms, which can effectively improve positioning accuracy and perform better under some complex occlusion conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Emergency Rescue Support Capability of Civil Aviation Airports Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In response to the problems of inconsistent evaluation models and standards, as well as poor reusability of related knowledge achievements, in the process of evaluating the emergency rescue and support capabilities of civil aviation airports, the article uses relevant theoretical methods of emergency rescue management to obtain the evaluation factors of emergency rescue and support capabilities of civil aviation airports, and obtains actual evaluation data of emergency support capabilities of 20 large, medium, and small airports in China through questionnaires and visits, Finally, the AI Decision Method in the data mining algorithm is used to conduct knowledge mining on the data, in order to determine the key elements and decision-making criteria for evaluating the emergency rescue support capacity of civil aviation airports. The feasibility of this evaluation method was verified through theoretical analysis and practical application.

Author Keywords: Assessment of emergency rescue support capability

articleTitle: Metamorphic relationship generation based on Faure Sequence Initialized Slime Mould Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Metamorphic relationship is an extremely important software testing method in the field of software engineering, and after years of research by scholars, a relatively complete system has been formed. However, the objective function of the metamorphic relationship generation algorithm is essentially a non-differentiable L1 norm, which means that the algorithm can finally be transformed into a non-smooth optimization problem. If traditional gradient dependent methods like gradient descent (GD) or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) are used, the objective function cannot be solved. The coordinate descent (CD) or sub-gradient descent (SubGD) methods usually used to solve the objective function are prone to falling into the trap of local minima, making it difficult to find the global optimal solution. Therefore, it is necessary to find a derivative-free optimization method to solve the objective function of metamorphic relationship generation algorithm. In this paper, a novel slime mold algorithm (SMA), which is called the Faure sequence initialized SMA (FSSMA) has been proposed for global optimization of the objective function. FSSMA can effectively overcome the shortcomings of CD and SubGD methods. Through numerical experiments, the effectiveness and computational efficiency of FSSMA have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: User Cooperative Receiving Scheme of Misaligned OAM Signals for UAV Emergency Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the massive users in post-disaster scenario, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can rapidly establish emergency communications, and orbital angular momentum (OAM) can significantly improve spectrum efficiency (SE). Due to hollow divergence and alignment requirement, it is hard for users to receive OAM signals by using antenna-limited devices. For UAV emergency communications with line-of-sight link, we propose the user cooperative receiving (UCR) scheme, which can realize 2 OAM mode multiplexing communications for users at long distance. Two cooperative users (CUs) are chosen, and the waist radius is adjusted to guarantee the maximum intensity at two CUs. The OAM beam steering is designed to eliminate the inter-mode interference of misaligned OAM signals caused by the antenna misalignment. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed UCR scheme can obtain higher SE than the traditional scheme due to the effective reception of misaligned OAM signals for UAV emergency communications.

articleTitle: Non-Markovian Memory-Based Model for Sequence Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Recognizing the non-Markovian nature of natural language and visual information, we introduce a Non-Markovian Memory-Based Model (NMM) that adjusts dynamically to the training data sequence. This novel approach uses memory-augmented networks and non-Markovian learning to capture complex dependencies in sequential data such as text and images. Our model features a memory module for storing and retrieving past input information and a learning mechanism for long-term dependencies, dynamically updating with new embedding and positional memory vectors as new tokens appear. Our extensive experiments show that using memory vectors based on token position significantly improves learning effectiveness over traditional DNN models. The NMM's performance, demonstrated across various datasets, highlights its superior accuracy and adaptability in tasks such as token prediction and image recognition, marking a significant advancement in machine learning research.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection Based on Spatio-Temporal Dynamic Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The rapid advancement of emerging technologies, such as cloud computing, big data and artificial intelligence has facilitated a holistic digital transformation of society. This transformation has led to an increased diversity and complexity in network traffic and behavior, thereby presenting new challenges to cybersecurity. Network traffic anomaly detection plays a vital role in enhancing network security situation awareness and maintaining cyberspace security. However, existing anomaly detection algorithms are designed for single links and local networks, overlooking the interactive connection features(CF) of traffic during communication, making it difficult to capture the correlation between network traffics. To address this limitation, we proposed an anomaly detection algorithm based on spatio-temporal dynamic graphs that extract network interactive connection features (CF) by modeling network traffic as dynamic graphs while incorporating statistical features (SF) inherent in the traffic itself. Experimental results based on the IDS2017 public dataset show that by integrating all available spatio-temporal features, our algorithm outperforms comparative deep learning models and machine learning algorithms in terms of both accuracy and F1 score.

articleTitle: Coverage Hole Aware Data Routing for Mobile Sink Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the coverage hole problem is one of the challenging problems that needs an effective solution. Data routing protocols in WSNs aim to disseminate the sensors’ data to the central device with the minimum possible network resource usage. However, suppose there is a coverage hole in the middle of the source and destination nodes, and the source node doesn’t have information about the hole. In that case, the data may choose the longer and more repetitive path to reach the destination, increasing resource usage, mainly energy and time. The condition is even more challenging when the network employs a mobile data collector. This paper proposes a Coverage Hole Aware Data Routing (CHADR) protocol for Mobile Sink WSNs that determines the shorter hole bypassing path in advance at the source node using the hole and data collector location information. CHADR evaluates the path efficiency using directional angle and expected hops count. After determining the path, data will be transmitted to the mobile sink using an Opportunistic routing technique. We proved CHADR performance with experimental simulations.

articleTitle: Cross-modal Spectral Fusion Model for Referring Video Object Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Referring Video Object Segmentation (R-VOS) demands precise visual comprehension and sophisticated cross-modal reasoning to segment objects in videos based on descriptions from natural language. Addressing this challenge, we introduce the Cross-modal Spectral Fusion Model (CSF). Our model incorporates a Multi-Scale Spectral Fusion Module (MSFM), which facilitates robust global interactions between the modalities, and a Consensus Fusion Module (CFM) that dynamically balances multiple prediction vectors based on text features and spectral cues for accurate mask generation. Additionally, the Dual-stream Mask Decoder (DMD) enhances the segmentation accuracy by capturing both local and global information through parallel processing. Tested on three datasets, CSF surpasses existing methods in R-VOS, proving its efficacy and potential for advanced video understanding tasks.

articleTitle: Multi-view Ordinal Regression with Dimensionality Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Ordinal regression (OR) builds up the classifier on the data that the different categories are in an order. The majority of the existing approaches consider OR as a single-view learning problem, and only a little work is presented for multi-view OR (MVOR). Moreover, they build up the model on the original data and do not take the high-dimensional data into account. In this paper, we propose an novel dimensionality reduction approach for multi-view ordinal regression (DMVOR), which has the ability to handle the MVOR problem with high-dimensional data. DMVOR performs dimensionality reduction on high-dimensional multi-view data by mapping it into subspaces and learns a classifier in each subspace. The view consensus constraint is proposed to ensure the label consistency between different views. Numerical studies have illustrated that DMVOR outperforms the compared OR algorithms.

articleTitle: A Federal Learning Framework for Privacy-protected Distributed Power Theft Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aiming at the security problem of electricity consumption data, a federal power theft detection method is proposed. The method does not need to upload the power consumption data to the data center, and can extract the power consumption features through local training, which reduces the risk of data leakage. Compared with other federal detection methods, this method uses the user's local data to train the model, which improves the privacy protection ability and anomaly detection accuracy. In the comparison experiment with the baseline method, the F value of the proposed method reached 94%, and the false positive rate and false negative rate were lower than the existing federal anomaly detection method.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Online Model System for Urban Water Pipeline Network Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In response to address issues such as one-way information flow, difficulty in GIS data exchange, inability to achieve cross departmental data sharing, and increasing data silos, this article proposes a design of a data-driven online model system for urban water pipeline network based on GIS. It adopts a service-oriented SOA architecture and comprehensively utilizes Internet of Things technology, big data technology, WebGIS technology to achieve network topology relationship management, pipeline inspection and operation, pipeline leakage control, and water supply scheduling simulation. This study conducted corresponding testing and analysis on the operational effectiveness of the system. In terms of pipeline leakage control, 86% of the marketing water volume can be fixed within the secondary partition water meter. In terms of pipeline network online models supporting for business systems, water supply scheduling simulation accounts for the largest proportion, about 60%.

Author Keywords: online model system for pipeline networks

articleTitle: WiFi Indoor Localization Based on Enhanced Dual-layer BiLSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the popularity of IoT devices, the indoor Internet of Everything has put forward higher requirements for location-based services. And due to the shielding effect of buildings on GPS signals, GNSS is almost unavailable indoors. Therefore, it is of great significance to study indoor positioning technology with high reliability and accurate positioning. In recent years, the popularity of WiFi has promoted the development of indoor positioning technology, and WiFi-based positioning technology has become the focus of research. Existing research basically does not consider the impact of different APs on positioning results when establishing WiFi fingerprint databases, thus leading to large positioning errors. In order to solve the problem of low WiFi RSSI positioning accuracy, this paper proposes a neural network DL-BiLSTM based on an improved double-layer BiLSTM. The introduction of the Attention mechanism makes the network pay more attention to APs that are closer to the reference point, thus improving the positioning accuracy. Experimental results on public data sets show that the average error of our network is 0.95m with 100% of the errors under 2.5m. Compared with the existing method DLSTM, the mean position accuracy is improved by about 37%.

articleTitle: Subjective Privacy Information: Concepts, Models and Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This study addresses the limitations in existing privacy protection mechanisms by proposing a novel subjective privacy information model. Our model analyzes privacy information from the subject's perspective, identifying it as a combination of subjects and privacy attributes in various environments. Utilizing quantum decision theory, we establish a measure framework for subjective willingness to expose privacy information. Additionally, we quantify the degree of privacy attribute attachment through subject anonymization. The resulting subjective privacy information sensitivity measure framework incorporates willingness to expose privacy attributes and attachment degree. By collecting diverse individuals' attitudes in different environments, we explore and validate the model's insights into privacy information properties. This research establishes a theoretical foundation for future subject-centered privacy protection strategies, aiming to enhance their effectiveness.

articleTitle: Multiple Enhanced Contrastive Learning for Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Collaborative filtering is a widely used technique for recommender systems, but it suffers from data sparsity, which leads to poor model robustness and generalization. In this paper, we propose a multiple-enhanced contrastive learning model that can balance the collaborative and augmented information in the recommendation model. Our model consists of two branches: one branch uses the original bipartite graph to learn the collaborative information, and the other branch uses an augmented graph to learn the augmented information. We use a contrastive fusion layer to merge the two branches and optimize the contrastive learning objective. The contrastive fusion layer can effectively enhance the robustness and generalization of the model by fusing the augmented graph representation and the embedding representation optimization information while retaining more high-order interaction information. We evaluate our model on three public datasets and compare it with several baseline methods. The experimental results show that our model can significantly improve the recommendation accuracy.

articleTitle: KeySim-FLMacBERT: A Law Recommendation Algorithm for Hard Example Mining in Work Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: There is a complex legal system in work safety, but currently only manual means are used to recommend law, and intelligent methods are urgently needed. To address law recommendation for hard examples, we propose a law recommendation model using data augmentation named KeySim-FLMacBERT, which is an improved version of MacBERT and is optimized from both data and algorithm perspectives: KeySim module leverages a keyword library of work safety laws to enhance the illegal fact, and uses optimized SimBERT text generation method to achieve hard example mining; FLMacBERT module adopts a priori guidance-based weight optimization strategy to optimize α in Focal Loss instead of cross entropy. Experiments prove the feasibility of our model on a real dataset of illegal facts and law of work safety in Beijing. The weighted F1 score of our model on all samples is 96.64%, and the F1 score on hard examples is 99.22%, exceeding the cross entropy by 3.06%.

articleTitle: Variable-Length Two-Stage Preamble for mMTC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: To enhance the access success performance and energy efficiency (EE) of preamble transmission for IoT devices in massive machine-type communications (mMTC), this paper introduces variable-length two-stage preamble (V-TSPA) to the random access (RA) policy. The proposed V-TSPA can not only resolve detection ambiguity issues in multi-stage preamble but also increase the number of available preambles, thereby improving the access success probability. Additionally, to meet the EE requirements of IoT systems, a feedback mechanism is incorporated into the proposed V-TSPA-based RA scheme. Simulation results show that, compared to traditional single-stage preamble (S-PA)-based RA schemes, the proposed scheme can effectively improve the access performance and energy efficiency of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Simulation Optimization of Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna Based on Pelican Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Based on the linkage between MATLAB and HFSS. In this paper, the Pelican Optimization Algorithm (POA) is used to optimize a rectangular microstrip patch antenna operating at 28 GHz for 5G communication. In the case of no algorithm optimization, using ANSYS HFSS simulation software simulation, the antenna return loss is -25.98dB, and the voltage standing wave ratio is 1.11. After using POA optimization, the return loss of the antenna is -35.47dB, and the voltage standing wave ratio is 1.03, the return loss is reduced by -9.49dB and the standing wave ratio is also reduced by 0.08. It is concluded that using POA optimize the size of rectangular patch antennas can be a better choice in communication.

articleTitle: Two-stage Floor Plan Recognition with a Network Employing Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The floor plan recognition task often requires architects to craft with their professional skills and tools. To solve this problem, this paper introduces a new two-staged approach for floor plan recognition. In the initial stage, rough segmentation of room regions is accomplished. Utilizing an attention mechanism guided by room boundaries, our network is directed to focus on the relationship between house boundaries and room regions, resulting in pixel-level segmentation for room regions. In the second stage, we integrate the rough segmentation result with the boundary vectors and architectural symbols. The merged information undergoes a weighted scoring mechanism, then derives a unified semantic label for all pixels within a boundary closed-loop region. In summary, our approach not only achieves the room-level semantic segmentation, but also captures the interplay among boundaries, architectural symbols, and room regions, thus attains a comprehensive understanding of floor plans.

articleTitle: t-SNE Based on Halton Sequence Initialized Mountaineering Team-Based Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) is a classic manifold learning algorithm in the field of machine learning (ML), and it is a non-linear data dimensionality reduction method. Manifold learning generally constructs homeomorphic mappings from high-dimensional spaces to low dimensional spaces based on different mathematical ideas. The idea of t-SNE is to pursue the probability isomorphism of data distribution before and after projection from high-dimensional space to low dimensional space. Thus, its essence can be seen as solving the minimization problem of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence that measures the similarity of probability distribution before and after projection. t-SNE algorithm usually uses gradient dependent line search optimization methods to solve, but gradient dependent optimization methods are often prone to fall into the trap of local optimal solutions and unable to find the global one. To address this issue, in this paper, a non-derivative optimization method, which is called Halton sequence initiated mountaineering team-based optimization (HSMTBO) has been proposed to realize the parameter optimization of t-SNE, and its feasibility and advantages can be verified through numerical experiments.

articleTitle: The Research on Current Status of Electric Power Emergency Command Knowledge System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Sorting out the basic concepts of electric power emergency command knowledge, clarifying the "Work Safety Law", "Emergency Response Law" and other texts of the relevant provisions of the emergency command, combined with the specific requirements of the electric power industry emergency response to emergency disposal, improve the rules for the establishment of the emergency command knowledge system. According to the main body responsible for the division of the type of event, the establishment of the emergency command system structure, a clear organization, the key roles, electrical equipment, equipment Elements such as materials; collate the existing power emergency command related technology, emergency command platform, monitoring and early warning systems and other functions and application of the status quo, the establishment of emergency command technology and system application system.

articleTitle: Gradient Weighted Loss for Learning from Imbalanced Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Training Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) with imbalanced data is indeed a daunting task. Categories with limited training data often suffer from poor representation, resulting in reduced recognition accuracy. To tackle this issue, we introduced a gradient-weighted loss function when training the deep model. Our proposed loss function leverages the average gradients across each category in the validation set to determine the importance of training data for updating the DNN's parameters. Categories with larger gradients are taken as more important than the smaller ones. In the meanwhile, our proposed loss function can combine with existing loss functions and improve model performance further on the imbalanced training dataset. Our experiments, conducted on the imbalanced CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets, demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms the compared methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Computing、Computational Power、 Computational Power Networks and Technology Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Entering 2022, AIGC, represented by foundation model such as ChatGPT, GPT4, Sora, and GPT-4o, is breaking through the wall rapidly. Generative artificial intelligence foundation model technology is rapidly iterating and continuously evolving, becoming a revolutionary tool for content generation, knowledge production, and human-computer interaction. With the increasing number of parameters in foundation model and the increasing complexity of deep learning algorithms, the demand for computing power in foundation model is further increasing. Massive data and large-scale parameters result in extremely large computational loads, limited storage on a single computer server, and limited computer capabilities. Training a foundation model with billions of parameters requires tens of thousands of GPU cards for synchronous computation, and high-performance computing power networks have become the main method and means to meet the demand for large computing power.This paper summarizes the development process of intelligent computing, explores the demand for computing power under the background of large models, and analyzes computing power, computing power networks, and technology ecology based on this, and analyzes their related technologies.

articleTitle: APT Detection Based on RSDN Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) represent sophisticated cyberattacks orchestrated by highly skilled groups, often with support from nation-states or criminal entities. These attacks are meticulously planned and executed against strategic objectives, exhibiting prolonged duration. Identifying and forecasting APTs accurately remains challenging. In this paper, we propose an integrated framework of machine learning models on a big data, referred to as the Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and Deep Neural Network (RSDN) System. The scheme collects network traffic data and uploading files. Subsequently, the data undergo processing using Resilient Distributed Datasets, employing one-hot encoding techniques, and splitting the datasets into training and testing sets within the spark big data platform. Moreover, we evaluate three different models within the RSDN system and integrate them into scenarios to identify the most effective scheme for detecting APTs. The experimental evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach in combating APTs, providing valuable insights for cybersecurity practitioners and achieving remarkable accuracy rates of 95% to 98% in their initial phase.

articleTitle: Research on The Development Trend of Digital Twin Industry Based on Multi-source Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As the digital age accelerates, digital twin has gradually become an important means. Which can promote orderly convergence and utilization of data, comprehensive integration of technology, comprehensive optimization of business processes. Quantitative analysis in the field of digital twin can systematically show the development trends. This article analyze technical composition and industry connotation of digital twin. Select and analyse multi-source information such as enterprises, papers, patents, standards and bidding. Then, analyzes the development trend of industrial supply, scientific research breakthrough, technological innovation, standard formulation and market demand of digital twin. Finally, put forward targeted policy suggestions.

articleTitle: Personal Credit Evaluation Model Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As the economy grows rapidly and consumer attitudes towards spending change, there has been a surge in demand for credit services, prompting the government to relax lending policies. However, this has also led to an increase in personal credit risk, causing the rate of non-performing loans to rise year by year. To address this challenge, experts and scholars have utilized artificial intelligence technology to design a variety of personal credit assessment models, effectively reducing credit risk. Nevertheless, the privacy and sensitivity of financial data have limited data sharing, leading to the phenomenon of data islands, with some small and micro banks potentially lacking sufficient data to train models. This paper introduces a new personal credit assessment model based on federated learning and the DeepFM model, aimed at solving the data sharing issue. It enhances model quality and accuracy through training with federated learning while ensuring data privacy and security.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband High Precision Positioning System Based on EDS-TWR and EKF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Traditional indoor positioning techniques that rely on time-of-flight and trilateration often encounter issues with measurement accuracy and stability due to clock drift and frequency deviation inherent to conventional ranging methods. Addressing these challenges, this study introduces a novel strategy by incorporating an Extended Double-Sided Two-Way Ranging (EDS-TWR) technique, further enhanced by the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) to reduce positioning errors. An Ultra-Wideband (UWB) positioning system, utilizing STM32 and DWM1000 modules, was developed to facilitate a comparative analysis. The results reveal that the system based on the EDS-TWR algorithm significantly outperforms the traditional Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA)-Chan approach, achieving an 80.53% increase in positioning accuracy and a marked improvement in stability. This confirms the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in enhancing high-precision wireless indoor positioning systems.

articleTitle: MSIHNet: A Multi-size Image Hiding Method That Can Hide A Large-Size Image into A Small-Size Image
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Image hiding is a task of hiding one image into another without being detected. Current image hiding methods can only achieve the same size hiding, but in real life we may encounter the task of hiding a large-size image into a small-size image. We propose a multi-size image hiding method to solve the problem of image size mismatch. Firstly, we convert the secret image into four small-size sub-bands LL, LH, HL and HH by using discrete wavelet transform. Secondly, according to the different importance of different sub-bands in visual effects and the different hiding effects of different hiding sequences, we hide HH and HL sub-bands into LH sub-band, and then hide LH and LL sub-bands into the cover image. All the hidden networks use the structure of reversible networks. Finally, we recover the secret image by inverse discrete wavelet transform. Experimental results show that our method outperforms other methods on PSNR and SSIM values of the recovered secret image and the stego image in the face of the task that hide a large-size image into a small-size image. Our code can found at: https://github.com/ziencheng3/MSIHNet.

articleTitle: FGLNoRe: Federated Graph Learning on Non-IID RF Fingerprints for Building-Floor Positioning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has revolutionized indoor positioning based on radio frequency fingerprints. Furthermore, federated learning has been introduced to address the challenges of data sharing without compromising location privacy in indoor positioning. In the context of federated learning, there is the inherent heterogeneity among fingerprint data from diverse mobile clients. Moreover, federated learning approaches overlook the underlying spatial correlations among access points (APs). Therefore, we need to improve model aggregation techniques and integrate graph learning techniques into federated learning to effectively learn from heterogeneous and spatially correlated APs. This paper proposes the FGLNoRe algorithm (Federated Graph Learning via Normalized Averaging with Regularization), a federated graph learning method for fingerprinting-based building-floor positioning in large-scale three-dimensional scenarios. The method introduces federated graph learning via normalized averaging with regularization to integrate federated learning with graph convolutional network (GCN). Extensive experiments on a real Wi-Fi fingerprint dataset validate that our method achieves a building-floor positioning classification accuracy of 0.85 in the presence of high-level data heterogeneity.

articleTitle: Encrypted Network Traffic Fine-Grained Identification Mechanism Based on Data Fingerprint and Multi-Classifier Decision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Addressing the issues of high computational overhead, prolonged model training time, and coarse granularity in existing encrypted network traffic perception technologies, this paper proposes a fine-grained identification mechanism for encrypted network traffic based on data fingerprints and multi-classifier decision-making. By utilizing rules for extracting data fingerprints from encrypted network traffic, this mechanism achieves feature extraction of encrypted network traffic data, allowing for precise characterization of encrypted network flow data at the transport layer. Subsequently, a fine-grained analysis method for encrypted network traffic based on multi-classifier decision-making was designed. By integrating several small model encryption traffic classifier algorithms such as SVM and KNN algorithms, and using the voting decision of multiple classifiers, this method conducts a fine-grained analysis of encrypted network traffic. It identifies and analyzes the encryption status of network flows, the application types of encrypted network flows, and the content types of encrypted network flows, providing robust decision support for subsequent malicious network traffic perception. The method achieved commendable experimental results in the authoritative dataset ISCX VPN-nonVPN, verifying the effectiveness of this mechanism.

articleTitle: MDR-TCN-BiGAtt model based IoT intrusion detection in fog environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In recent years, fog computing and IoT convergence have contributed to increased cyber attacks. Thus, the fog nodes are vulnerable to high-dimensional anomalous traffic attacks due to their limited computing resources. To address this issue, we propose an intrusion detection model termed MDR-TCN-BiGAtt in this paper. Specifically, this model utilizes an improved feature selection algorithm for dimensionality reduction. It employs BiGRU to capture anterior-posterior temporal dependencies in features and includes a TCN layer to reduce computation and expand the data acceptance domain, enhancing the model's detection performance. Furthermore, we incorporate an attention mechanism into the model to determine the importance of assigned features, thereby enhancing the extraction of crucial features. To assess the performance of our model, we conducted evaluations using two widely accessible datasets, namely UNSWNB15 and IOT-23. The experimental results substantiate that our model outperforms existing models in accuracy, precision, and recall. Additionally, it exhibits faster convergence for intrusion detection in IoT within the fog computing environment.
